fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2026-04-27, around 18:20, a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 3,500 was withdrawn, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-04-27. Buvaneswari Sri submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000294. A further person, Logesh Karuppasamy, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000198, is stated to be associated with the incident. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100068, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. The complaint mentions Ajith Nathan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000297, in connection with the events. A witness, Ramya Bai, reachable on 9000000232, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned transaction records and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, mobile number, transaction record, bank account, associate, apartment complex, phone records
